notes: Indecomposable iff some finite reduction is indecomposable; minimal degree has finite nonzero witness; each canonical prefix computable

statement: Explicit Z and Z/2 generators and complete split WG form classification over complete Noetherian local odd finite-residue rings, with exact branch-access operations

statement: Split WG injects into its finite-quotient inverse limit with image exactly compatible sequences uniformly bounded in representing ranks and coefficient degree

notes: Exact quotient-free coordinate subset given by ∃B,D∀N finite decidable predicate; all operations stream coordinatewise using only finite quotient access

statement: Split WG over arbitrary products of complete Noetherian local odd finite-residue rings is exactly the uniform-rank-and-degree bounded image in the product of local groups
depends_on: C:complete-finite-bounded-image; integral finite free coefficient basis; coordinatewise idempotent/Gram/isometry assembly
